tables.title: Average biweekly expenditures per urban household a/
tables.source_note: Consumers' Price Survey, Bureau of Statistics.
footnotes: a/ Figures are a population weighted average of actual yen expenditures as reported daily by a sample of approximately 5,000 families in 26 representative cities on Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu. Size of family varies by city, average ranging from 4.1 to 5.5 persons.
